title: AI Process Automation for Recurring Workflows | utxo AG
description: AI process automation by utxo AG: recurring cases are read, checked and posted in your existing systems. Exceptions go to your team for approval.
tagline: AI process automation for recurring workflows
lede: Orders, invoices, requests and documents are read, checked against your rules, posted in your existing systems and answered. Your team decides the exceptions.

faq.q: Which processes are suited to automation?
faq.a: Processes that occur often, follow clear rules and are transferred by hand today between an inbox and a business system: order intake, incoming invoices, requests, master data changes or document checks. Whether your process is a fit is something we clarify in the first conversation, using real cases.

faq.q: Do we have to replace our systems?
faq.a: No. The automation works with the systems you have in place and uses their interfaces. If a system offers no interface, we assess during the project which route is sound.

faq.q: What happens when the automation is uncertain?
faq.a: Cases that do not meet every rule or cannot be read unambiguously go to your team for approval, with the reason attached. Every step is logged, so each case can be traced and corrected.

faq.q: How long does it take to go live?
faq.a: That depends on the process, the number of special cases and your systems. Some use cases are in production within a few weeks, others take months. Once the process is documented, we can estimate the effort.

Hosting follows your requirements: Germany, the EU or on-premise, decided per project. We process data only on your instructions and do not train models with your data. The DPA is drawn up individually for each project.

faq.q: Which AI models do you use?
faq.a: We work model-agnostic and choose the model according to the task and the data protection requirements. Local open-source models are assessed per project.

scope.title: What you get
scope.text: An automation for one clearly defined process in your company, for example order intake. It reads every case, checks it against your rules and completes it in your systems.

points.name: Read
points.text: The automation recognizes the relevant details in emails, PDFs and forms and turns them into a structured record.

points.name: Check
points.text: Every case is checked against your rule set and your master data: customer, items, prices, limits, dates.

points.name: Post and reply
points.text: If a case meets every rule, the automation creates it in your ERP, sends the reply and files it in the CRM.

points.name: Exceptions
points.text: If something deviates, the case goes to the person in charge, with the reason attached. After approval it continues.

points.name: Log
points.text: Every step is recorded: what was read, which rule applied and who approved.

reader.label: Animated example: an incoming purchase order is read, its details are captured as a record and checked, and one deviation is flagged.

example.title: One order as an example
example.text: A wholesaler receives purchase orders by email as PDFs. If an order meets every rule, it is created in the ERP and confirmed without anyone stepping in. If a price deviates from the price list, the sales office decides.

flow.label: Animated example: two purchase orders are checked against five rules. The first is posted and confirmed without intervention; the second waits for approval because of a price deviation and then continues.

project.title: How a project runs
project.text: We start with one process and with real cases. How long it takes to go live depends on the process and on your systems: some use cases are in production within a few weeks, others take months.

steps.name: Document the process
steps.text: In the first conversation we select one process with you. Using real cases, we record how your team works today and where it decides.

steps.name: Define the rules
steps.text: Together with your department we define what the automation completes on its own and what goes to approval.

steps.name: Connect the systems
steps.text: We develop the automation and connect it to the inbox, ERP and CRM through interfaces, with its own restricted access.

steps.name: Trial operation
steps.text: The automation handles real cases and your team approves every single one. This shows where rules are missing or too strict.

steps.name: Operation
steps.text: After your acceptance the automation completes cases on its own. We host and monitor it and adjust rules when your process changes.

phases.label: Animated diagram: today your team handles every case. In trial operation the automation handles cases and your team approves each one. In operation your team decides only the exceptions.

rows.name: Today

rows.name: Trial operation
rows.text: The automation handles the cases, your team approves each one.

operation.title: Operation and control
operation.text: The automation works in your existing systems. utxo AG develops, hosts and monitors it. Your team sees at any time what is running and decides where it matters.

points.name: Your systems stay
points.text: The automation reads from the inbox and writes to the ERP, CRM or DMS, through interfaces and with its own restricted access.

points.name: You set the limits
points.text: You define limits, tolerances and approval paths. Every change to the rule set is logged.

points.name: A person approves
points.text: Exceptions reach the person in charge with the reason and the details concerned. They approve or send back.

points.name: We operate
points.text: utxo AG monitors operation, resolves incidents and adapts the automation when formats or processes change.
